name: DEVICE_REFERENCE_REGULARIZATION_V1
preview: load immutable Device Reference identity/current descriptive name from LLD-03
if already resolved, show exact current Network Element and correction path rather than creating another resolution
search candidates using independent descriptive evidence: normalized operational name, manufacturer serial, represented IP, Site and Model when available
rank/display evidence without converting any score or exact descriptive match into identity authority
operator explicitly selects existing Network Element or chooses create-new with authoritative Site/nonblank name
bind selected target/current revisions and a scope fingerprint
obtain the LLD-12 deliberate-action proof after the governed hold; obtaining proof is not validation, consumption or business authorization
commit: inside one UnitOfWork resolve idempotent replay and re-read Device Reference, current resolution and selected Network Element or creation inputs
recompute the exact action target, base revision and scope fingerprint from current authoritative state

for UI promotion requiring the governed three-second hold, call LLD-12 DeliberateActionProofProvider.validate_and_consume(uow, proof, expected_action, target, base_revision, preview_fingerprint); INVALID, EXPIRED, already-consumed or stale-bound proof aborts with no mutation
if create-new, create one Network Element and explicit unracked placement projection; optional descriptive/model/IP facts use normal services in same transaction
append resolution event/current row; never update any SR/RFC/Task/Inventory relationship target
audit Device Reference + Network Element result refs and commit
correction: Changing a wrong resolution appends correct/clear/link relationship history after exact review. It preserves both immutable identities and does not reopen terminal Tickets.
rules: deliberate proof validation and single-use consumption occur inside the same authoritative UnitOfWork as the regularization mutation; verify-only proof checking before mutation is forbidden
a consumed proof cannot authorize a second regularization attempt even with the same payload
regularization may occur after terminal related Tickets
same Network Element may deliberately resolve multiple Device References only after explicit review
unregistered Device Reference remains fully valid
